questions.text: How clear are the AI-related expectations for your current role at LHIND?
How confidently can you explain the differences between classic software solutions, machine learning, and generative AI?
How often and effectively do you already use AI tools for research, text, code, analysis, or concept work?
How well can you structure prompts, improve them iteratively, and critically review AI results for errors, bias, and gaps?
How confidently can you identify and prioritize meaningful AI use cases with visible business value?
How well can you assess which data sources, data quality, and data volumes an AI use case needs?
How well do you know and apply the relevant guardrails for data protection, IT security, ethics, and responsible AI use?
How confidently can you integrate AI systems into processes and teams while keeping humans accountable and roles clear?
How routinely do you structure AI initiatives with scope, risks, stakeholders, pilots, and rollout?
To what extent do you actively shape new AI-based solutions, workflows, or services and share your experience?

academyPaths.title: Introduction to GitHub Copilot
academyPaths.audience: Developers, business analysts, and knowledge workers with little or no Copilot experience.
academyPaths.prerequisites: Basic digital skills and access to GitHub Copilot; no advanced AI knowledge required.
academyPaths.summary: Learn Copilot interaction patterns, supply useful context, apply suggestions to real work, and verify code, privacy, and quality before accepting results.

stages.label: Acquire
stages.focus: Copilot modes, prompts, context, boundaries, and safe everyday use.

stages.label: Deepen
stages.focus: Apply Copilot to code and document work, then review the resulting change.

stages.label: Create
stages.focus: Verify AI-assisted changes with evaluation, tests, and release-quality gates.

academyPaths.title: Agentic Software Engineering

academyPaths.prerequisites: Software development, Git, automated tests, terminal use, and a modern IDE; coding-assistant experience is helpful.
academyPaths.summary: Use coding agents, engineer prompts and context, design RAG and agent workflows, and verify generated code with explicit security and delivery controls.

stages.label: Acquire
stages.focus: Coding-assistant workflow, context, review, and task boundaries.

stages.label: Deepen
stages.focus: Agent loops, RAG, function calling, MCP, and prompt-injection defenses.

stages.label: Create
stages.focus: Build a reliable agent harness and defend its architecture and operating controls.

academyPaths.title: AI Systems and Architecture
